Acrobatic Build.description:
💪 Build: Acrobatic Build
Light and flexible — moderate height with lean muscles built for dynamic movement. The kind of frame that flips, tumbles, and catches ledges.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Acrobatic Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Acrobatic frame — lean and flexible, compact muscle focused in the core and legs. The body reads light and spring-loaded, built for movement. Female: shoulders narrow and level with the hips, slim neck, soft small jaw, a light chest line over a compact waist. Male: shoulders slightly wider than the hips, lean corded neck, defined jaw, flat chest over a tight waist. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own frame at this agility.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
